requestShape: same as sam-table; prompts from sam-cutout/prompts.json (drawing, toy)
notes: Real probe 2026-10-28 on a Pixel 9 Pro XL photo. One request per prompt (Responses API, one concept each). With the Responses API default store:true, bodies above roughly 530 KB (a 1440x2560 JPEG of ~446 KB, base64-encoded) were rejected with HTTP 401 invalid_api_key while 1600 px (~270 KB) and 2048 px (~397 KB) succeeded; with store:false (now in the templates) the full-size photo succeeds too. Keep store:false on every SAM call. Latency is per prompt; a 5-prompt table scan with 3 in flight is ~2 round-trips. usage.images_processed=1 per request. drawing-01: 'drawing' mask clean (c=0.945), 'toy' absent as expected. costUsd is per request; a 2-prompt cutout is $0.005.
